def guard(event,args):

    if event=="open" and isinstance(args[0],str) and pathlib.Path(args[0]).name.startswith(".env"):

sys.addaudithook(guard)

exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[future]+nodes,type_ignores=[])),paths[0],"exec"),worker.__dict__)

assert len(tests)==10

exec(compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=tests,type_ignores=[])),paths[3],"exec"),ns)

print(json.dumps({"tests_passed":10,"full_worker_imported":"worker" in sys.modules,"source_hashes_unchanged":True}))
